solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

parts.note: a sound bouncing back off a wall is a resounding comeback, not a sporting return

explanation.surface: A team or performer staged a triumphant return to form.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound that reverberated back to its source did exactly this, so the past tense fits.

clue.text: Insect with wings of short span

definitions.text: Insect with wings of short span

parts.words: Insect with wings of short span
parts.note: the mayfly genus bears this name, and the word also means things lasting only a short span of time

explanation.surface: A naturalist describes a small flying creature with stubby wings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short span' reads as wingspan, but it is a short span of life: the mayfly lives a day.
explanation.definitionFit: The mayfly genus shares its name with the word for short-lived things, matching a brief life span.

clue.text: Straying in herd can result in obstruction

indicators.note: cattle that stray wander out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cattle wandering from the herd can block the road.
explanation.definitionFit: An obstruction is something that holds you back, a synonym of the answer.

indicators.note: the answer travels across the words take a sea, sitting within them

explanation.surface: Advice to unwind by going on a cruise.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the end of 'take' through 'a' into 'sea'.
explanation.definitionFit: To relax is to slacken or loosen, a verb sense of the answer.

indicators.note: something melting loses its shape, so the letters of crib clue are re-formed

explanation.surface: A setter offers a crib for the phrase melting pot.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted 'melting pot' looks like the definition; only 'pot' defines, and 'melting' is the anagram signal working on 'Crib clue'.
explanation.definitionFit: A crucible is a pot in which metals are melted, a specific kind of the vessel.

parts.note: ending a call by hanging up, and also the ring on a finger being called off

explanation.surface: Someone wants to end a phone call or cancel an appointment.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting down the receiver ends a call; an engagement ring suggests ending a betrothal too.

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: comes means arrives or appears
lines are wrinkles on the face

explanation.surface: A beauty shows up with a perfectly smooth complexion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' looks like 'lacking' but takes its old sense of 'outside', so one word surrounds the other; 'The' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Comeliness is attractiveness of appearance, a synonym for beauty.

clue.text: Fetch head of business to telephone

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: to ring someone is to telephone them

explanation.surface: An instruction to get the boss on the phone.
explanation.definitionFit: To fetch something is to carry it over, a synonym.

indicators.note: an amendment changes something, so the letters of secret are changed in order

explanation.surface: Someone brings up a hidden change to a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a building or mast is to put it up, a synonym.

clue.text: Sort of picture that's a topic for debate?

definitions.meaning: a formal debate argues a proposal put to the house

explanation.surface: Asking what kind of film would make a good subject to argue over.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinema is called the moving-picture form, and a debate proposal is the formal proposition argued.

definitions.meaning: a teacher tells pupils to lower their raised arms
on a clock at half past six both pointers face the bottom

explanation.surface: A classroom instruction issued at half past six.
explanation.definitionFit: A teacher stops a show of arms this way, and a clock face at half six shows it.

parts.note: main means chief or major

explanation.surface: A big state in the east of America.
explanation.definitionFit: Maine is the north-eastern American state, an example of one.

definitions.meaning: to pick out or single out
a con artist's target or dupe

explanation.surface: A detective names the person who was attacked.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick out is a verb sense; a swindler's target is the noun sense.

clue.text: Aviator happy to ignite the jets

parts.note: a pilot flies a plane
light as in light-hearted, cheerful

explanation.surface: A cheerful flyer starts up the aircraft's engines.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'jets' look like aircraft engines; they are gas burner jets on a boiler or cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A small permanent flame in a boiler serves to set the gas burners alight.

clue.text: Much improved, so enjoying greater popularity

definitions.meaning: said approvingly of something better, as in that's a lot better
read as more liked, so better loved

explanation.surface: Something has got a lot better and become more popular.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom expresses approval of an improvement, and punningly suggests being better liked.

explanation.surface: An instruction to find fault with an overview.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means disparage; the noun is a brief outline of points.

clue.text: Polish, perhaps, or not by the sound of it

indicators.note: points to a word heard rather than read

parts.note: or not Polish, but from a different nation: from Finland

explanation.surface: Someone wonders if a person is Polish or not, judging by the accent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' reads as the nationality; here it is the shine on furniture, an example of a surface treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A gloss or varnish coat is an example of a final surface treatment, as polish is.

clue.text: A good man with endless service as a writer

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good man in crosswords

indicators.note: the last letter of the word for the service is dropped

parts.note: evensong is the evening church service

explanation.surface: A virtuous man who never stops serving becomes an author.
explanation.walkthrough: Robert Louis Stevenson wrote Treasure Island.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Louis Stevenson was a Scottish novelist, an example of an author.

clue.text: Split up and set off with compass

indicators.note: set off means the letters of set go wrong, reordered

parts.note: range and compass both mean scope or extent

explanation.surface: A couple part and head off with a compass to navigate.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate two people is to drive them apart, as a separated couple is.

definitions.meaning: to fail in a duty, abandon one's side

explanation.surface: A complaint that a flaw is there by default.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it is a flaw; as a verb it means to abandon allegiance, defaulting on loyalty.

parts.note: not a fixed tower holding water but a moving vessel that tows on water

explanation.surface: A description of a water tower that moves.
explanation.definitionFit: A small powerful vessel that hauls ships is a tower on the water that does not stay put.

parts.note: to have something is to own it, so having is doing this

explanation.surface: A firm statement that something is compulsory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Have to' reads as 'must'; it is simply 'have', as in own.
explanation.definitionFit: Having something means owning it, so to have is to do exactly this.

definitions.meaning: printers produce trial copies to check, and photographers trial prints

explanation.surface: Protest marches staged by print workers and camera operators.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Demonstrations' suggests protests, but means demonstrating something true.
explanation.definitionFit: Evidence establishing a fact, and printers' and photographers' trial impressions, share the word.

clue.text: Some fine tuning for new task we accepted

indicators.note: the outer letters take in, or accept, the word we
new tells the letters of task to take a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A fresh job we took on involves minor adjustments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes TAKS from 'task', which 'accepted' wraps round WE.
explanation.definitionFit: Small adjustments to a car engine or a draft are examples of fine tuning.

definitions.meaning: the capital city of New Zealand
fillet of beef wrapped in pastry is named after the duke

explanation.surface: Asking whether a beef dish counts as first-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: It is New Zealand's capital and also a pastry-wrapped beef fillet dish, named after the Iron Duke.

clue.text: See the purpose of a parasite

parts.note: lo means look or see
a use is a purpose or function

explanation.surface: Someone tries to understand why a parasite exists.
explanation.definitionFit: A small wingless insect living on hair is a parasite, an example.

indicators.note: something created is made fresh, so these four letters are formed anew

explanation.surface: A nobleman is elevated and crowned.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragic monarch is an example of a king.

definitions.meaning: a nobleman in the House of Lords

explanation.surface: An exclamation drawing attention to a man, prefaced by Lord.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lord' reads as an exclamation, like 'Good Lord'; it is a noble.
explanation.definitionFit: A nobleman sits in the Lords; the verb means to gaze closely.

clue.text: Lincoln protected America from corrupt practice

indicators.note: the outer word shields the other inside it

parts.note: Abe is the nickname of Abraham Lincoln

explanation.surface: A president safeguarded his country from graft.
explanation.definitionFit: Misuse of power or position is a corrupt practice, a synonym.

clue.text: Not on time when business is slack

parts.note: off is the opposite of on
a season is a time of year

explanation.surface: Being late in a quiet period for trade.
explanation.definitionFit: The quiet time of year for tourism, when trade is slack.

clue.text: Cast Pete in play and watch

indicators.note: play suggests the letters are moved about freely

explanation.surface: A director gives Pete a role in a play and then watches.
explanation.definitionFit: To be an onlooker at an event is to watch it, a synonym.

parts.note: a bang is a straight-cut lock of hair over the forehead

explanation.surface: A blow to someone's skull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bang' sounds like a blow; in American usage bangs are hair cut straight across the forehead.
explanation.definitionFit: A straight-cut forelock of hair across the forehead is called a bang in the US.
